title: Gemini CLI
description: Google's Gemini CLI as a coding agent in Tomrade: conversations and tickets run on your own Gemini CLI over ACP with Tomrade's tools, a ticket can also go to Gemini CLI in a terminal, and its sign-in answers Tomrade's background calls.

why.fs: Reads Gemini CLI's settings in ~/.gemini to tell whether it can sign in and which model it uses; a background call runs in a temporary folder of its own and removes the session Gemini CLI saved for it under ~/.gemini/tmp.
why.exec: Runs your own `gemini` command: its ACP server for conversations, and `gemini -p` for background calls.
